description: Search the user's connected Outlook mailboxes and return matching messages, newest first: from, to, subject, date, a short preview, the mailbox it came from, and a web_link that opens the message in Outlook. `query` is Outlook search (KQL): plain words match anywhere, and from:jane@acme.com, to:jane@acme.com, subject:budget, hasattachments:true and received>=2026-09-01 narrow it. Pass folder='sentitems' for mail the user sent. Use this, not the Gmail tools, for Outlook mailboxes. If it reports Outlook is not connected, give the user the link it returns.

account.description: Email address of one connected Outlook mailbox. Omit to use every connected mailbox.

folder.description: Limit to one folder: 'inbox', 'sentitems', 'archive', or an id from list_outlook_folders. Omit for all mail.

name: search_outlook_messages
title: Search Outlook
